title: The Other Track
treatment: Winner C (the Explainer) with grafts from B (the Dramatist: the lever caught mid-throw between RULES and TENANT as the button, comments as mail sacks on a freight scale, the hearing at the water stop) and D (the Enthusiast: RULES ties laid ahead of an empty boxcar with its doors open that waits on the open siding). A rail junction near Houston in late-November Mat-Su snow. One track splits at a faceless switch stand: the AIDEA BOARD branch is short and closed, ending at a buffer stop with a lit window card; the Anchorage boardroom is a separate interior reached by a cut; the DNR branch is open and runs off frame into the birch. The switch stand is the protagonist and acts only through mechanism: its lever, its lamp and its target disc. Revised after Gate 0D round 1: no faced hero, no ribbon, no tag flip, no raven, no salmon, no red-family accent.

roles.sky: #D9D6C8 bone haze at the top of frame warming to #EFE8D6 sun-washed cream, with a #F6E7A8 lemon glow ONLY low on the right near the sun; no blue sky
roles.ground: #F3F1EA crusted snow lit, #E6D2A6 warm sun catch on drift crests; #F2EFE6 birch bark with #2B2A2A lenticel dashes; #1E2B24 spruce green-black treelines
roles.shadow: #9FB6CC lake-blue only in the near and mid cast shadows that carry meaning (the disc shadow, the switch, the cars), under about 30 percent of any exterior frame; far snow shade is warm bone #CFC6B4
roles.hero: the switch stand is value-led, not a second warm hue: #3B3F44 cast iron with #6A7077 worn edges, a bone #EFE8D6 target disc with a black bar (face A) and bone with the amber ring (face B, the ring is the accent), an iron lever ball; the disc faces carry no words
roles.accent: #F2A93B railway signal amber is the ONLY saturated warm in any exterior: the switch lamp, the disc's face-B ring and every DNR-clock date (NOVEMBER 30TH, 30 DAYS). Why amber: a lit switch lamp in the low winter light is what tells a crew which way the points are set, which is this story's question. The lemon glow stays under 30 percent chroma and away from the switch. AIDEA-side dates and plates (DECEMBER 7TH, the 12-tie count, FRIDAY) are bone or ink mono, never amber.
roles.rail: #8A4B2E rail rust with #A9785C desaturated worn tops (value, not hue, carries the rail), #5B4636 creosote ties
roles.boardroom: #4A4740 warm grey-brown wall, #C9B48A walnut, #F6E7C8 lamp warmth through frost
roles.possible: POSSIBLE is shown through mechanism, never an outline: an empty open siding with the points set toward it, and an empty boxcar parked on the open branch with its doors open and nothing inside, under the amber COULD lamp

palette.mood: bright, cold, legible, a little wry: a sunny winter noon where long shadows do the drama
palette.divergence: 11-24 was flat July overcast on olive tundra with signal red pins; 11-23 was apricot-plum civil twilight on lavender snow with a scarlet ribbon and cyan. This is a hard low noon sun on bone haze, birch white and rail rust, the accent is amber (yellow-orange, clear of both films' red family), blue only in shadows.

light.time_of_day: late-November noon near Houston, sun about seven degrees up in the south
light.direction: camera faces east toward the Talkeetna Mountains on the far plane; the sun sits low at frame right (south); shadows fall long to the left across the snow and across the tracks
light.key_fill_rim: warm low key from the right, a cool bounce from the snow below, a lemon rim on the right edges of the switch stand, the cars and the Suits; the boardroom is lit by a warm lamp pool with frost on the window and is the only interior; the AIDEA branch ends at a buffer stop with a lit window card, and the Anchorage boardroom is a separate interior set reached by a cut
light.depth: three planes on every exterior: the Talkeetnas and a spruce line in haze, the track bed and birch in the middle, a near snowbank with tufts and a rail end in the lower third; parallax drift on the far planes
light.lighting_lib: lib/lighting.tsx GradeLayer warmth +0.03, ContactShadow under everything grounded, long cast shadows drawn as lake-blue shapes to the left

shape_language: Divergence: one point splitting into two angles, closed against open. Every exterior is built on the track fork: the AIDEA branch is short and CLOSED (it ends at a buffer stop inside the frame), the DNR branch is long and OPEN (it runs off the frame edge). The world is verticals (birch, masts, spruce) and horizontals (ties, the snow line); the switch lever is the one diagonal, and its angle is the film's running state.

casting.hero: SwitchStand, NET-NEW reusable library asset (lib/rail.tsx): a faceless cast-iron railway switch stand that acts through mechanism, lever throw and tremble (hesitation), lean, a lamp that blinks and flares, a two-sided target disc that turns, `cues` for beat performance, and a long disc shadow for the signature shot. It breaks the faced-prop idiom of Specs and SampleTube: no eyes, no mouth.
casting.throughline: the lever position, introduced at 0 s and changing state at each act boundary: set toward AIDEA BOARD (0 s), trembling at the centre as the agenda passes (30 s), thrown to DNR as the land's clock starts (60 s), caught mid-throw between RULES and TENANT (button)
casting.supporting: Diesel (NET-NEW lib/rail.tsx, a plain faceless modern road diesel in cast-iron grey and bone, no face, no steam) pulling the agenda cut, RailLine and TrackFork (countable ties, a bare bed of empty ties before a line starts), Boxcar (stencilled label, doors, rolling wheels, or empty with its doors open), FreightScale and MailSack (c28's comments as mail, never a crowd), BufferStop (the closed end of the AIDEA branch), SusitnaBG and SnowBank (the world), Boardroom and WallClock (c12's closed session), SignalLamp (the COULD lamp), Billboard (c37's quote as THE PITCH), Suit (lib/people.tsx) for Kreiss-Tomkins and Ruaro, Lectern (lib/ballot.tsx) for the hearing.
casting.shelf_check: grep of ASSET_INDEX.md and lib/ for train, engine, boxcar, freight, rail, track, switch, scale, sack, buffer: Train1925 (lib/serum.tsx) is a sepia 1925 steam train with a fixed palette and no stencil or doors; depot.tsx is a freight depot set with no rolling stock; nothing switches, counts ties or carries a label. The gaps are the switch, the countable ties and the labelled boxcar. SusitnaBG reuses the DepotBG/NearDrift construction re-graded to noon (a new seedable world because 11-16 required seeded skies per shot). FreightScale and MailSack carry c28; BufferStop carries the closed AIDEA branch (shape language). Train1925 and the 11-23 sepia family stay out of frame; wide shots lead with the switch and the fork, never a long single track to a vanishing point. No steam locomotive in any frame.
casting.people_rules: Named people are faceless Suits with boxed name cards, never characterized, never a speech bubble; Ruaro at the hearing lectern stays faceless with a name card and his quote sits on a plate attributed to him. Residents are never drawn; their comments are mail sacks.
casting.cut: Raven (three films running) and Salmon (out of season, no habitat claim) are cut. Ambient life is drifting powder, birch sway, snow sparkle, an air-brake exhaust puff and frost breath at the couplings.

motion_language: Trains roll with wheel spin and a little body sway, and brake with a squash and an air-brake exhaust puff. The lever throws with anticipation, a clank and an overshoot, and trembles when it hesitates. Ties count on one by one with a tick. Powder drifts and sparkles across every exterior as the always-running layer. Hero moves that earn motion blur: the agenda train passing, the switch throw, the boxcar leaving down the open branch.

composition.focal_hierarchy: the switch stand or the fork first, the car or the plate second, the land third
composition.negative_space: the empty open siding the points are set toward, and the bare bed of five empty ties in the day-count beat
composition.safe_area: hero action and plates inside y 420 to 1500 for the 1:1 square; the far range and sky stage the top of the 9:16; a near snowbank, rail ends and the foot of the switch stand fill y 1472 to 1920
composition.signature_shot: ONE image, low and wide at the switch at noon, about 58 s: the lever throws with an overshoot, and the target disc's long blue shadow sweeps across both branches and settles on the open DNR track as the amber lamp flares. Hold on it. The day count is a separate ordinary explainer beat afterwards: ties (not shadows) are days, 12 on the closed AIDEA branch to its buffer at DECEMBER 7TH, 5 bare ties then 30 laid ties on the open DNR branch running past it.
composition.plates: mono plates sized by arithmetic, one per beat, ladder y 560 to 760, every claim plate carries its source
composition.fork_geometry: the DNR branch diverges to frame LEFT of the stand (the disc shadow falls left, north, and settles on it); the AIDEA branch goes to frame RIGHT toward its buffer stop

craft_advance: none beyond the net-new lib/rail.tsx family; engine advances go to the weekly machine pass
